results.question: What was our net sales revenue in 2011?
results.challenge: Calendar-year filter; net = sales minus cancellations/returns.
results.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') AND invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01'

results.question: Which products were returned most last quarter?
results.reference_sql: SELECT stock_code, any_value(description) AS description, SUM(-quantity) AS returned_units FROM transactions WHERE line_type = 'cancellation' AND is_product AND invoice_date >= '2011-07-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-10-01' GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY returned_units DESC LIMIT 5
results.agent_sql:
WITH cancellations AS (
    SELECT stock_code,
           any_value(description) AS description,
           SUM(-quantity) AS returned_units
    FROM transactions
    WHERE line_type = 'cancellation'
      AND invoice_date >= TIMESTAMP '2011-07-01'
      AND invoice_date < TIMESTAMP '2011-10-01'
      AND is_product = TRUE
    GROUP BY stock_code
)
SELECT stock_code,
       description,
       returned_units
FROM cancellations
ORDER BY returned_units DESC
LIMIT 200
results.agent_answer: Products returned most in Q3 2011. Top of the list: PANTRY CHOPPING BOARD (943); HOME SWEET HOME MUG (847); COLOUR GLASS. STAR T-LIGHT HOLDER (728).

results.question: Compare total transaction value with net sales value.
results.challenge: Two different definitions: all rows vs sales minus returns.
results.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS total_transaction_value_gbp, ROUND(SUM(line_value) FILTER (WHERE line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation')), 2) AS net_sales_value_gbp FROM transactions
results.agent_sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(line_value) AS total_transaction_value FROM transactions), net AS (SELECT SUM(line_value) AS net_sales_value FROM transactions WHERE line_type IN ('sale','cancellation')) SELECT ROUND(total.total_transaction_value,2) AS total_transaction_value_gbp, ROUND(net.net_sales_value,2) AS net_sales_value_gbp FROM total CROSS JOIN net LIMIT 1
results.agent_answer: Total transaction value vs net sales value: total transaction value £18,909,762.10, net sales value £19,057,376.18.
